quiz.question: What expertise brings Louise Banks onto the first-contact team?
quiz.explanation: Banks is recruited as a linguist to help understand the visitors.

quiz.question: How many alien spacecraft arrive around Earth?
quiz.explanation: Twelve spacecraft arrive at locations around the planet.

quiz.question: What nicknames does Ian give the two aliens?
quiz.explanation: Ian nicknames the two heptapods Abbott and Costello.
evidence_markers: Donnelly nicknames them Abbott and Costello

quiz.question: Which translated word causes alarm when the aliens describe their offer?
quiz.explanation: The translation “weapon” alarms governments; Banks argues it may mean a tool or means.

quiz.question: Why does Banks think the nations must share their findings?
options: Each ship holds a different part of the complete message
Only China has a working radio
The aliens refuse to speak to scientists
Every ship uses a different human language
quiz.explanation: Each craft supplies one part of a message that requires international cooperation to decipher.
evidence_markers: full message is split between the twelve craft

quiz.question: Why do the heptapods say they are helping humanity now?
options: They want a permanent military base
They will need humanity’s help in 3,000 years
They are searching for a lost human ship
quiz.explanation: Costello says the heptapods will need humanity’s help in 3,000 years.

quiz.question: What does learning the heptapods’ language change for Louise?
options: Her ability to breathe aboard the ship
quiz.explanation: The language changes linear time perception, allowing memories of future events.

quiz.question: What are Louise’s apparent memories of Hannah revealed to be?
quiz.explanation: The visions concern a daughter who has not yet been born.

quiz.question: What does Louise recite to General Shang to help stop the attack?
options: The names of all twelve ships
quiz.explanation: She recites his wife’s dying words, using information learned during a future meeting.

quiz.question: What is the title of the book Louise writes about the heptapod language?
quiz.explanation: Her book is The Universal Language, a guide to the heptapods’ language.

facts.title: A title that took a different direction
facts.text: Villeneuve changed the original title because it sounded like a romantic comedy to him. Arrival was the first suggestion from his producers and writers.

facts.title: Quebec standing in for Montana
facts.text: The production filmed mainly around Montreal; Saint-Fabien represented Montana. Principal photography lasted 56 days.

facts.title: Spacecraft with an asteroid reference
facts.text: The look of the heptapods’ ships was inspired by asteroid 15 Eunomia.

facts.title: Real linguists behind first contact
facts.text: McGill linguists advised on the production: Morgan Sonderegger on alien sounds, Lisa Travis on workplace sets, and Jessica Coon on the script.

facts.title: A score outside the Oscar race
facts.text: The prominent use of Max Richter’s existing music made Jóhann Jóhannsson’s score ineligible for the Academy Award for Best Original Score.
